1.title: Place the body
1.description: Set the main body part in the center of the build area as the base for later steps.

2.title: Attach the head
2.description: Connect the head to the top of the body and align the studs before pressing down.

3.title: Add the beak
3.description: Install the orange beak on the front of the head, matching the orientation in the guide.

4.title: Add the eyes
4.description: Place the eyes symmetrically on both sides of the head at the same height.

5.title: Finish the wings
5.description: Attach both wings last, then check that the model feels stable. Build complete.
